rawFindings.title: Incorrect pub/sub key splitting in on_ready recovering subscriptions
rawFindings.explanation: In RedisClient.prototype.on_ready, when replaying subscriptions after reconnecting, the code originally modified the key splitting logic from using split(' ') to using indexOf and slice. However, if the key does not contain a space, indexOf returns -1, causing slice to produce incorrect parts array elements. This can cause invalid command names or arguments to be sent when restoring subscriptions, leading to subscription failures or errors.
rawFindings.suggestion: Change the splitting logic to robustly handle keys that might not contain spaces. For example, check that space_index is not -1 before slicing, or fallback to splitting by space. Alternatively, revert to using key.split(' '), as the previous implementation correctly split the keys into [command, argument].
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: If subscription_set contains keys without spaces, the new code will produce invalid command names like parts[0] being incomplete or wrong, causing errors or failed subscription replays after reconnecting.
